live._declaredRoutes: Routes to probe WHETHER OR NOT anything links to them. The crawl reads anchors, so a screen the sidebar omits is invisible to it — on SMILE Beggary that hid three real screens and caused two more to be redirected away as duplicates. List every route you know of that the navigation does not surface: detail pages, create forms, statutory pages, anything reached by a button. A declared route that captures nothing FAILS the run, so a wrong entry here is loud rather than silent.

baseline._modes: tokens (strict, vs inputs/tokens.json) | derived (from Figma variables) | internal (no DS — flag outliers)

notes: Passwords live in secrets.json (gitignored), keyed by role name. Never commit them.
_claimGates:
Set true once this project has resolved anchors (projects/

/sheet/anchors.json) and a design dump from engine/figma_dump.js. Then `run.py --phase claims` is FATAL: no finding ships without a crop pair, no anchor sits on the element beside the one the sentence is about, and no design read is trusted unless it can prove the page was loaded.
_allowSharedAnchors: Pairs of finding ids that legitimately share one design box — normally a global and its per-screen twin. Everything else that shares a box is a copy-paste and fails the duplicate-anchor gate.
